label: C2 holds exactly when its weak form and its difference hold
paraphrase: For every frame, reading world, esse map, reception relation, receptive-potency relation and matter-form predicate: C2 holds if and only if C2-minus holds and every contingent being with a distinct esse CAUSE_2 is existentially receptive or has a SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 one. A premise-free comparison; it asserts none of the three statements.
